strings.description: Device Settings row (tappable, opens upload details): some recordings were uploaded but the server has not accepted or processed them yet. Calm status, not an error.

strings.en: Your audio is safe on your device or phone
strings.description: Subtitle under 'Uploads waiting on the server' in Device Settings: reassures that the recorded audio is still stored on the Omi device or the phone, so nothing is lost while the server catches up.
